baselineEvidence: browser-agent reports only, no raw frame sequences
scope: Practice vs Bot only; never online human match; research-only, no Torre2 runtime changes
notes: Optimized against reported uses, not against visually confirmed effects.
Sequence prioritizes fewest untested default cover sets using deterministic greedy selection; it is not a globally proven minimum.
Team builder defaults, roster and IDs are from 2026-10-31; verify on site because the provider can change them.
A match marked planned is not an executed match; all actions must be separately evidenced.
Protected moves are research references only, not authorization to replace Torre2 VFX.
Server queues or premature KO may prevent use of some planned moves; carry them forward instead of falsely marking done.
Do not spend metered browser credits while site access, queue and visual capture remain unresolved.
Source IDs of default moves are resolved against 127-entry public roster; prior optimizer omitted 42 IDs carried by default slots in the older plan.
